attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: one original-size-compatible Hearts of Iron IV character portrait replacement.
Image 1 is the original HOI4 portrait and composition target. Image 2 is the user's exact 奶龙 identity reference: a smooth golden-yellow round creature with green rings around black eyes, a small horizontal mouth and creamy belly.
Replace the human head, body and exposed human skin with this recognizable yellow mascot. RETAIN the original person's visible hairstyle, hairline, hair color, eyebrows, moustache, beard and sideburns as distinguishing features attached to the mascot, adapting them to its round head. Match the original's parting, thickness, curls and facial-hair shape. Preserve a bald scalp or clean-shaven face only where the original actually has one. Do not invent hair hidden under a hat.
Preserve the original garment design, uniform type, fabric, colors, headgear, glasses, decorations, accessories, expression, gaze, pose, action, framing, lighting, background and painterly color treatment. RETAILOR the collar/neck opening and shoulder fit to the mascot rather than copying a narrow human neck opening. Keep all existing garment design details and insignia; do not invent new hats, uniforms, medals or symbols. Use only visually present features; do not infer appearance from filenames or historical biographies.
Keep the yellow creature's anatomy, large green-ringed black eyes and small horizontal mouth; do not restore human skin, human nose or human ears. Express the original mood through its creature eyes and mouth plus retained eyebrows.
Facial-hair placement: wherever the original has a moustache and chin beard, their top-to-bottom order is eyes, UPPER-LIP moustache, small horizontal mouth, chin beard. Never place the visible mouth above the moustache or turn the moustache into a second beard. Clean-shaven originals stay clean-shaven.
Collar and anatomy: use a compact rounded mascot head seated close to broad shoulders, with a very short, wide neck transition. No tall cylindrical/giraffe neck, no long tapered yellow stalk above the clothing. The entire neck base must fit INSIDE a correctly sized collar opening. Widen and reshape the collar opening naturally around that base while keeping the original collar style, tabs, piping and badges. Collar front sits visibly in front of the lower neck; collar back sits behind it, with coherent perspective, contact shadow and fabric tension. No neck clipping through collar, pinched narrow ring, floating collar, broken seam or abrupt geometric junction. The creamy belly stays under opaque clothing; never add a cream/white bib on the neck. Respect this fit even for tiny advisor or pilot portraits.
The head silhouette is nearly round or a SHORT egg shape. Its chin rests immediately above the garment collar, without copying the original human neck length. Preserve the shoulder position and crop by broadening the fitted garment; do not fill that space with a tall yellow column.
The garment meets the underside of a visibly rounded chin. There is no separate exposed vertical neck column between the head and collar, including bald and three-quarter-view portraits.
The lower head silhouette curves inward toward its base instead of continuing down as parallel straight yellow sides. Raise and broaden the original collar and shoulders to meet that curved chin; do not insert an extra yellow neck roll underneath it.
Keep the source's fastening state: a buttoned closed standing collar remains closed and buttoned, with both front ends meeting naturally at the center seam. Do not turn a closed military collar into a deep V-neck or unbuttoned shirt. Preserve open lapels/shirt collars only where the original is actually open.
Preserve the source aspect ratio, crop and number of figures. Preserve real alpha transparency, photographic frames, note cards and existing decorative markings where present. Do not add such framing where absent. Polished painterly HOI4 finish, legible at the original in-game size. One source image to one asset. No comparison board, new text, label, watermark or extra figure.

Visible source-specific features: Small adviser photograph card: preserve the dark tilted frame and pale note overlapping its right side, original silhouette, shadows and alpha. Keep short neatly combed dark hair, round light wire-rim spectacles, source-visible facial-hair appearance, and dark military high-collared tunic with red-and-gold collar details. Do not invent a cap or beard. Fit the cloth collar broadly directly beneath the compact round yellow chin without a tall neck or cream bib. Preserve original note markings as texture, not invented readable words.
Output alpha: keep a genuine fully transparent RGBA background outside the portrait silhouette. No painted gray backdrop, halo, studio gradient or rectangular plate. Retain the source's clothing, hair, headgear and portrait crop.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actual returned fullsize image invents a dense moustache AND pointed chin goatee. The actual original adviser card, also confirmed against its visually matching large Asia generic land 1 source, is CLEAN-SHAVEN. Remove all upper-lip and chin hair, keep skin areas smooth yellow. Preserve short side-parted black scalp hair, eyebrows, original thin GOLD subtly rounded RECTANGULAR spectacle frames (not large round frames), and olive CLOSED tunic with original red collar tabs, buttons and pose.

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the actual raw-HD mascot edit target. Image2 is the exact original game portrait/card and sole authority for visible features. Image3 is the user mascot identity reference.
Actual observed correction: 确切小原图下巴为光滑皮肤、耳前鬓毛短，金色眼镜为较扁的镜片轮廓；当前原始高清 PNG 新增明确独立下巴毛簇和下垂至脸颊下部的长鬓角，并将镜片改成近圆大圈。上唇也画成浓短胡须，不能用原图该处薄暗边自动证明浓胡须合理；至少下巴毛簇/长鬓角及眼镜形状改变是当前确定缺陷。须按确切小原图恢复短发/短鬓及光滑下巴，核对并保留原上唇实际状态，恢复较扁金色镜片轮廓；不以相反朝向同名大图代替小图。继续保留军服闭领、短宽领口接触和纸条上部约两行模糊标记。白/青底及 alpha 已实际查看，照片内背板、人物/深衣物与纸条内部不见挖空；透明在卡片外，本次返修针对毛发及眼镜。
Keep all unrelated source-visible hairstyle and hair colour, eyebrows and exact fine facial-hair state, glasses, headgear when actually present, clothes/neckwear, badges/buttons/straps, expression, gaze, pose, crop and lighting. Source-visible eyebrows remain distinct independent brows; never erase them to copy the identity reference smooth forehead or merge them into head hair. Smooth golden-yellow compact round mascot head with green-ringed black eyes and exactly ONE small mouth at the actual original mouth position. If a moustache is present, that one mouth is below it: never add a second grey slit, beak, nose or default mascot lip above the moustache. No human skin/nose/ears, broad invented facial-hair band or hat replacing real hair.
Only when the original actually has a photograph frame/note, retain that entire tilted frame and overlapping paper, opaque photographic backing and true exterior alpha outside the complete original card. Copy the actual original note markings as required visual shapes: preserve their original number of row/groups, compact footprint, placement and dark contrast. Keep original blank paper blank outside that footprint. Do not erase original marks, replace them with random stains or dots, spread writing over the page or invent extra rows. These existing indistinct marks are required original image content, not a request for newly readable words. A standalone full portrait retains its entire original painted backdrop and must not acquire a new photo frame or note. Preserve genuine original transparency only where it really exists. Dark cloth stays fully opaque. Short broad fitted neck with rounded chin immediately meeting actual garment, preserve its open/closed state and do not add a neck column, separate roll, cream bib or floating collar. The exact original controls mouth opening, smile shape and source-visible tooth edge; do not import the mascot reference closed grey lip over an open source mouth. Keep full raw-HD detail, resolution and original aspect ratio; no newly invented readable text, extra note writing beyond the actual original footprint, watermark, new symbols, people or panels.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original photograph FRAME AND NOTE silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual tilted photo rectangle, frame rim and overlapping note intact. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
